help: Lists every home you own with its number, condition, tenant and rent. The other lls_ commands take that number.
Shows everything about one home: value, condition, stats, traits, upgrades, services, tenant, children and the last log lines. A home is its number from lls_homes or "here" (where you are docked).
Gives you a new home on the market you are docked at, for free. Size is shack, studio, small_house, house, villa or estate (or 1 to 6). With no size, one this market sells.
Lists the homes for sale on the market you are docked at. With reroll, a new list replaces it.
Sets a home's condition. 0 condemns it.
Repairs every home you own to 100% for free and cleans off graffiti and dirt.
A new tenant moves into an empty home at once, with all traits known. The faction is the market's own unless you name one.
The tenant leaves the home at once.
People apply to rent an empty home, 3 unless you give a number. See them on the home's Tenants tab.
Sets the tenant's mood, which adds to their happiness and drifts back to 0 by 1 a day.
Sets the tenant's wealth, from E (1) to S (6).
Adds or removes a house trait. lls_ids housetraits lists them.
Adds or removes a tenant trait, or reveals all of the tenant's traits. lls_ids tenanttraits lists them.
Makes a house or tenant event happen now, whatever its odds. lls_ids events lists them.
Builds an upgrade at once for free, or removes it. lls_ids upgrades lists them.
Puts furniture in your furniture storage, 1 unless you give a number. all gives every piece. lls_ids furniture lists them.
Hires a service for a home, or cancels it if it is already hired. lls_ids services lists them.
Runs the end-of-month pass now: rent, wear, reputation and your family's money. The rent shows in this month's income report.
One of your officers or administrators marries you and moves into the home, whatever their level. You move into the home first if it is empty.
Your partner has a baby now.
Every child in the home grows up now. Talk to them to choose their path.
Sells a home at its price, like the Sell button on the Real estate tab.
Lists the ids the other lls_ commands take.
